arms.XYQ: bxy_p11 XY-quadratic, lambda_J = 1.0 (P12 lambda*), original objective

bottlenecks_ranked.evidence: edited-Y Shapley share 0.36-0.42 of the corrective gap; within-root edited-Y AUROC 0.42-0.48 OOF and only 0.55-0.58 on the models' own training roots; P(Y_edit) - P(Y0) ~ +0.12..+0.16 whatever the recorded labels (edit-contrast agreement 0.00-0.06 on S0-feasible roots); a hand-made 8-clearance probe reaches pooled edited-Y AUROC 0.69 vs 0.59
Y0 Shapley share 0.13-0.28; Y0 AUROC 0.83-0.89 on training roots vs 0.65-0.71 OOF; the probe reaches 0.77 OOF; Y0 is 1 of ~20 terms per root (5.6 % of the joint NLL)

27-33 % of travel-arm choices on infeasible roots reject a verified repair whose p exceeds P(Y0) (MISSED_PENALTY_REJECTED; 13 % at gamma = 0); a penalty-free rule doubles-to-triples corrective success but repairs 55-65 % of feasible roots under the P12 models (because of B1's constant edit bonus)

contrasts.C4: PONLY vs PRIMARY on the same checkpoints, every arm
contrasts.C5: XYQ+CON+GEO with PONLY vs XYQ with PRIMARY (pre-specified combination)

decision.IMPROVES: paired root-cluster bootstrap (B = 10000) delta success on infeasible roots: CI95 lower > 0, AND delta unnecessary-repair point estimate <= +0.05
decision.TARGET_MET: IMPROVES and delta success point estimate >= +0.10
decision.multiplicity: five pre-specified contrasts; 95 % CIs reported plus whether each survives Bonferroni (99 % CI); development evidence only
decision.no_post_hoc_change: criteria, arms, coefficients and rules are not changed after any P14 result

endpoints.guardrail: unnecessary repair rate on the 131 initially feasible roots
endpoints.primary: verified success on the 45 initially infeasible roots (seed mean per root, OOF)

CON.definition: per root, all pairs (s, t) of observed Y nodes (Y0 included) with y_s = 1, y_t = 0: l_root = n_obsY(root) * mean_pairs softplus(-(b_s - b_t)); L = L_joint + lambda_J L_J + kappa * mean over the batch roots of l_root (roots without a discordant pair contribute 0)
CON.kind: training objective (auxiliary, NOT the exact likelihood)

GEO.definition: b_s = scene(v_s, c) + mlp(8 -> 128 -> 1)(phi(S_s)); phi = bxy_p13.geo_features of the (edited) scene from the scorer's own tensors (object centres / radii / target flag, robot base, goal), distances / 0.08 m (cell units), counts raw; no label, witness, teacher or catalogue field
GEO.kind: geometry-aware control on the Y unary only

PONLY.definition: argmin -log p over F1-admissible candidates incl. the no-op (alpha = beta = gamma = 0, eta = 0, no gate), ties by (m, C_d, signature)

not_targeted.clipping: 0 % of batches exceed the clip norm at initialization, ~65 % at the restored checkpoints, dominated by X|Y terms of sharpened logits; no evidence that clipping limits the fit
not_targeted.query_normalization: Y0 under-fit is not the problem (training-root AUROC 0.83-0.89); re-weighting would not address generalization

protocol.folds: 5 family-grouped folds over the 176 roots (bxy_p11.folds procedure, early-stop subset inside each training part)
protocol.roots: the 176 original TRAIN roots only (val21 and the 34 exposed test roots excluded)
protocol.training: bxy_p11.TRAIN unchanged; early stopping on the exact joint NLL (XY) / success BCE (DIRECT) for every arm

selection_rules.PRIMARY: P11.1 PRIMARY (alpha 0.1, beta 0, gamma 0.05 for lambda_J-trained XY arms, 0 for DIRECT)
